header-desc: Decode Shenzhen. Connect the Future. Your digital survival guide for APEC.
ai-planner-desc: Tap to customize your tech & culture tour with Gemini AI.
ar-decoder-desc: Translate menus & signs with cultural context.
connected-desc: eSIM setup & airport Wi-Fi without SMS.
drone-desc: Experience Meituan drone delivery at Talent Park.
robotaxi-desc: Guide to fully autonomous rides in Nanshan.
tab-route-desc: Manage your curated tech safaris and local experiences during the summit.
tab-profile-desc: APEC 2026 Delegate • Manage your preferences, privacy, and safety settings.
tab-leader-desc: Discover the most popular check-in locations among APEC delegates.
lang-prompt: Select your preferred language for the Nexus interface and AI translation outputs.
loc-lianhuashan-sub: Futian • City Panorama & Deng Xiaoping Statue
ai-concierge-desc: Ask anything about Shenzhen or APEC.
hire-guide-desc: Enhance your tour with a bilingual local expert.
leader-fusion-desc: Every destination now carries dining, concierge, and pass-ready merchants nearby.
leader-fusion-tip: Tap any spot to see a business-break route, nearby merchants, and premium services.
ai-concierge-prompt: Ask me about Shenzhen weather, business etiquette, transportation, or APEC schedules.
ai-concierge-placeholder: e.g., How do I exchange business cards in China?
ai-planner-time: How much time do you have?
ai-planner-interest: What do you want to see?
ai-planner-placeholder: e.g., I want to visit DJI Sky City and eat spicy hotpot for dinner...
pay-tip-desc: Set this up before arriving in China to ensure you can receive SMS verification codes from your overseas bank.
pay-step1-desc: Use your home country phone number.
pay-step2-desc: Go to Account > Settings > Real-name Verification. Scan your passport.
pay-step3-desc: Go to Me > Bank Cards. Add your Visa, Mastercard, or JCB.
pay-w-step1-desc: Register for WeChat first. You may need a friend to verify your account.
pay-w-step2-desc: Go to Me > Services > Wallet > Cards to add your foreign credit card.
mob-map-desc: Google Maps data is inaccurate in mainland China. Use Apple Maps for accurate walking and public transit directions in English.
mob-emer-desc: Play these AI-generated native phrases to your driver if you can't find the pickup point.
mob-p1-en: I am waiting at the ride-hailing pickup area.
mob-p2-en: Please come to the underground parking (B1).
conn-restrict-desc: Google, WhatsApp, Instagram, and X are blocked in mainland China without a VPN or roaming data.
conn-s1-desc: Buying a travel eSIM before you arrive means you instantly have unfiltered internet upon landing. No VPN required.
conn-s2-desc: Most public Wi-Fi in China requires a Chinese phone number to receive a verification SMS. To get online at Shenzhen Airport:
conn-s2-l1: Find a "Wi-Fi Password Kiosk" near information desks.
conn-s2-l2: Scan the photo page of your passport on the machine.
conn-s2-l3: It will print a ticket with a PIN code to connect.
ar-upload-desc: Upload or take a photo of Chinese menus, signs, or text.
drone-desc-full: Experience the future of logistics. Order coffee or snacks and a drone will drop it at a designated kiosk in Shenzhen Talent Park within 15 mins.
drone-s1-desc: Walk to the designated drone landing kiosk near the south entrance of Talent Park.
drone-s2-desc: Open Alipay → Search "Meituan" → Select a nearby cafe → Choose "Drone Delivery" at checkout.
drone-s3-desc: When the drone arrives, scan the QR code on the kiosk screen to unlock your order.
robo-desc: Shenzhen is one of the first cities in the world to allow fully driverless taxis on public roads.
robo-s1-desc: Download Apollo Go or Pony.ai from the App Store. Register with your passport number.
robo-s2-desc: Robotaxis operate in designated zones in Nanshan and Qianhai. Set your pickup within these areas.
robo-s3-desc: The car will arrive with no driver. Enter using the app, confirm your trip, and enjoy the ride.
merchant-unavailable-tip: This merchant is currently unavailable. Please select an available one.
order-create-failed: Failed to create the order. Please try again shortly.
order-pay-timeout: Payment status sync timed out. Please refresh the order status shortly.
order-pay-init-failed: Failed to start payment. Please try again.
order-pay-unavailable: Stripe publishable key is missing, so real card payment is unavailable.
payment-result-paid-desc: Your order has been paid successfully. You can close this panel and continue your trip.
payment-result-failed-desc: The payment did not complete. Please try again with another card or retry.
payment-result-timeout-desc: We have not received a final payment status yet. Please retry shortly or check the latest order status.
pass-duplicate: You have already claimed this Pass
redeem-duplicate: This Pass has already been redeemed
ai-planner-warn: Please select at least one tag or enter a request.
ai-planner-error: Failed to generate. Please try again.
route-empty-hint: Use AI Planner to create your first itinerary
ai-concierge-error: Failed to get an answer. Please try again.
ar-error-empty: Empty result. Please try another image.
ar-error-analyze: Image analysis failed. Please try again.
ar-error-read: Failed to read image. Please try again.
route-maps-tip: Apple Maps is recommended for accurate walking and transit directions in Shenzhen.
drone-hero-sub: Unlock air-delivered food, arrives in 15 mins
drone-guide-s2-sub: Confirm the airdrop cabinet near you
drone-guide-s3-sub: Address auto matches cabinet, pay normally
drone-guide-s4-sub: Enter phone tail number, pickup and recycle box
drone-night-desc: China's first drone night delivery is here in Shenzhen!
drone-night-hours: Hours: 10:00–20:00, order food even at night!
drone-tip-1: Order early on weekends — pickup when you walk by the cabinet
drone-tip-2: Arrive 5 mins early to watch drone landing, super futuristic!
drone-tip-3: Recycle the food box after pickup, eco-friendly for next user
drone-faq-q1: Is there extra fee for drone delivery?
drone-faq-a1: No! Same delivery fee as regular food delivery, no extra charge.
drone-faq-a2: Flight only takes 4–6 mins, total 15 mins from order to pickup, 40% faster than regular delivery.
drone-faq-a3: Heavy rain, strong wind (>10m/s), or fog will pause service for safety. Check the App notice before ordering.
drone-mall-wow: Window of the World, Splendid China, Happy Valley
robo-hero-sub: Experience future travel, free L4 autonomous ride
robo-ap-s1-sub: Complete real-name verification, bind phone number
robo-ap-s4-sub: Scan code to open door, enjoy the autonomous ride
robo-po-s2-sub: Select station in Nanshan/Futian pilot area
robo-po-s4-sub: Car auto opens door, enjoy full autonomous ride
robo-night-desc: Both platforms support night operation — experience it even late at night!
robo-tip-1: Book 1–2 days early on weekends to secure a slot — try both platforms
robo-tip-2: Check your belongings before getting off, don't leave items in the car
robo-tip-3: Don't touch buttons inside the car; call in-car customer service if needed
robo-tip-4: No eating or drinking in the car — keep it clean for the next rider
robo-faq-a1: Very safe! L4 AD has been tested over millions of km with multi-sensor obstacle avoidance. Both platforms have full safety systems.
robo-faq-q2: Do I need a driver's license?
robo-faq-a2: No! You're just a passenger. No license needed — just complete real-name verification on either platform.
robo-faq-a3: Yes! Up to 3 passengers per car. All riders need real-name verification — book together.
robot-desc: Meet AI robots, robot dogs & humanoids across Shenzhen.
robot-hero-sub: Explore future tech, interact with AI robots up close
robot-mu-s1-sub: WeChat search '深圳科学技术馆' mini-program, complete real-name verification
robot-mu-s2-sub: Tickets released at 20:00 daily — book in advance
robot-mu-s3-sub: Bring ID, check in with your booking
robot-mu-s4-sub: Go to 3/4F for robot coffee, dog show and more
robot-st-s1-sub: Scan the booking QR at the store entrance, fill in personal info
robot-st-s2-sub: Wait for your turn, usually 10–20 mins
robot-st-s3-sub: Follow staff guidance to interact with robots
robot-tip-1: Museum tickets sell out fast — released at 20:00 nightly, grab them early
robot-tip-2: Robot dog shows run on a fixed schedule — check the timetable when you arrive
robot-tip-3: Don't touch robot sensors — it may disrupt their operation
robot-tip-4: You can chat with the robots — they understand you and will reply!
robot-faq-a1: Most projects are included in the museum ticket. Robot coffee costs extra. Basic store experience is free; some deep experiences are paid.
robot-faq-a2: Absolutely! Great for kids — learn while playing. Children under 6 enter free with a parent.
robot-faq-a3: Yes! Photos are welcome. Some robot performance areas may restrict flash — follow staff instructions.
robot-faq-a4: Most museums are closed on Mondays; stores are usually open. Confirm before you go.
meta-desc: VR, AR & XR immersive experiences across Shenzhen.
meta-hero-sub: Immersive metaverse — cross the boundary of virtual and reality
meta-pu-s1-sub: WeChat search venue mini-program, complete real-name verification
meta-pu-s2-sub: Museum tickets released at 20:00 — book in advance
meta-pu-s3-sub: Bring ID, check in with your booking
meta-pu-s4-sub: Get device at the area, enjoy immersive projects
meta-st-s1-sub: Follow store WeChat account, book your time slot
meta-st-s2-sub: Weekends are busy — arrive 10 mins early
meta-st-s3-sub: Staff will help you wear the device and enter the virtual world
meta-hours-desc: Most VR/AR projects have fixed hours — plan your trip in advance!
meta-hours-note: Most venues are closed on Mondays — confirm before you go!
meta-tip-1: Museum tickets sell out fast — released at 20:00 nightly
meta-tip-2: Don't eat too much before — avoid motion sickness; drink water after
meta-tip-3: Tie long hair back for easier headset fitting
meta-tip-4: If you feel uncomfortable during the experience, call staff to stop anytime
meta-faq-a1: Basic public venue experience is free. Some XR projects cost extra. Store experiences typically need a ticket (50–150 RMB).
meta-faq-a2: Most projects are for ages 12+, some for 6+. Parent accompaniment required. Very young children are not recommended.
meta-faq-a3: A few people experience mild motion sickness — resting a few minutes helps. If you get carsick easily, choose gentler projects.
meta-faq-a4: Photos are welcome before the experience. Don't remove the headset during — and no flash please.
